notes.title: Furniture: Build&Repair 2.00
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

After a year of silence, I took some time, with the help of Vincent Py (big thank to him!), to bring a new patch for Furniture: Build & Repair!

It took a long time for me to release this patch due to the workload from my other game and activities, but now, here it is!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791309/8ba00d9f3fdfe4647efe2f75e607544a00ce95c9.jpg

We managed to fix a lot of bugs and clarify misunderstandings about how to build furniture:


 There is no longer a specific order to follow—you can now build in any order you want, as long as two pieces can be merged together!
 Some issues with achievements have been patched, and hopefully for good this time.
 The number of furniture pieces you can build has doubled, so you can have even more fun playing Furniture: Build & Repair!


I also lowered the price based on the feedback I received about the time/price ratio not being good enough.

-

Unfortunately, I won’t have the time or energy to do more for this game. I believe I’m leaving it in an "okay" state—not perfect, but good enough for you to have fun playing it.

I’m proud that this first game has sold almost 1,000 units, and I’ll use all the feedback you gave me, as well as the experience I gained from this project, to do even better in my next games—because I won’t stop creating games!


Thanks for your support and for playing Furniture: Build & Repair!


Su

notes.title: Patch v1.1.05 2/2
notes.content:
Correction Patch 2/2

Second patch to fix the issues of Furniture: Build & Repair! This patch took longer than expected due to problems related to achievements:

[olist]
Collisions have been corrected
All achievements are now available and unlockable
Some game-breaking bugs have been removed
[/olist]

Thank you for your patience and kindness. Even though it's not much, I added a small one-star table as a thank you to the 200 people who showed interest in Furniture: Build & Repair!
A big thank you to everyone who provided feedback and allowed the game to be corrected properly!

A major update will arrive in late February 2024 with many new pieces of furniture to build! I'm working hard on this update and hope you'll enjoy it!

notes.title: Patch v1.1.01 1/2
notes.content:
Patch of Fixes 1/2

You have identified several issues upon the release of Furniture: Build & Repair, so I took the time to implement some initial fixes:


It has been widely requested, so an "Exit" button has been added to the main menu!
Similarly, for sound settings, you can now adjust the game volume directly from within the game.
A comprehensive tutorial has been integrated for a better understanding of the game mechanics.
Some minor errors have been corrected as they should be.


Thank you for all your feedback and kindness. I will continue working on Furniture: Build & Repair to enhance your gaming experience and add more content!

The second part of the fix will be released on 01/30/2024, including corrections related to achievements and collision issues.
Additionally, an update to the Steam page is planned!

(To be transparent, the translation in most languages is done using a translation tool. If significant errors are present, I will correct them as quickly as possible!)
